title: Empty text part created prematurely when using Perplexity models with `extractReasoningMiddleware`
body:
### Description

When using `extractReasoningMiddleware` with Perplexity's `sonar-reasoning-pro` model, the client receives message parts in an unexpected order compared to other providers like Claude.

## Expected Behavior

Based on Claude model behavior:
- Client receives parts in order: `['step-start', 'reasoning', 'text']`
- Reasoning content appears before main text content

## Actual Behavior

With Perplexity models:
- Client receives: `['step-start', 'text', 'reasoning']`
- An empty text part appears early in the streaming process
- Text content is positioned before reasoning in the final structure

## Key Differences

**Claude models:**
- No source chunks in server stream
- Maintains expected order throughout streaming

**Perplexity models:**
- Includes source chunks: `source → reasoning-delta → text-delta`
- Creates empty text part early in client
- Results in unexpected final order

## Reproduction

Repository with minimal reproduction: https://github.com/liby/vercel-ai-perplexity-reasoning-bug

The repository includes detailed logging to show the streaming order at both server and client sides.

## Impact

This ordering issue affects UI display, as reasoning content is expected to appear before the main response text for proper context.

## Additional Information

The issue does not occur in AI SDK v4. With v4:

- Messages maintain correct order without empty text parts appearing early
- Using `createDataStreamResponse` with `mergeIntoDataStream` works as expected
- The issue appears to be specific to v5's handling of Perplexity's source chunks

### AI SDK Version

- ai: 5.0.2
- @ai-sdk/react: 2.0.2
- @ai-sdk/perplexity: 2.0.0
- @ai-sdk/anthropic: 2.0.0

linked_prs.title: fix(extractReasoningMiddleware): delay sending `text-start` chunk to prevent rendering final text before reasoning
linked_prs.body:
## Background

Using `extractReasoningMiddleware()` might result in text being rendered before the reasoning due to the `text-start` chunk being sent before the `reasoning-start` chunk is sent.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e9d96bbc-3ad1-4976-9d74-59835c99ff51

## Summary

When wrapping a text stream in `extractReasoningMiddleware()`, delay queing the `text-start` chunk until either `reasoning-start` was queued or the first `text-delta` is about to be sent, whichever comes first.

## Manual Verification

Using https://github.com/liby/vercel-ai-perplexity-reasoning-bug kindly prepared by @liby

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d0911850-d23f-4e1d-8861-b18041febc67
